title: Malicious code in @arks-labs/config (npm)
description: The npm package '@arks-labs/config' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise potentially grants full control to an outside entity, risking exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to the severity of the compromise, complete remediation may require rotating all secrets from a separate, trusted device.
